start: Any member on the Workout tab, no keyboard open

user_sees: Each tab opens; one highlight slides to the tapped tab
Three tabs only: Workout, Gym, Profile
must_not: A fourth tab (such as Progress or Shop)
Two screens opened by one tap

start: Member linked to a gym; the gym sent 3 messages not yet read

user_sees: A badge '3' on the Gym icon
must_not: A badge on Workout or Profile

steps.action: Gym sends 12 unread in all (messages, replies, ask answers)
must_not: A badge number that runs out of the circle

start: A new feature is waiting under the Gym tab, no unread messages

user_sees: A small new dot; screen reader says the tab has something new
must_not: The dot and a number shown together

start: Typing in a text box on any tab

user_sees: The tab bar and the workout bar step aside
must_not: The tab bar riding up on the keyboard

steps.action: Close the keyboard and tap the tab that is already open
user_sees: The tab stays as it is
must_not: The screen reloading or opening again

steps.action: Open the Gym tab and read the messages
user_sees: The badge goes down to none
must_not: The badge staying after the messages were read
The badge coming back after a restart

steps.action: Open the new feature behind the dot
must_not: The dot coming back after it was seen

start: Phone where a member left one gym and joined another, or two members used the phone

steps.action: Look at the Gym tab badge
user_sees: Only the unread count of the member now linked
must_not: A count that includes messages for another member id or another gym
